services.name: Wine Tours
services.desc: Visit our Clubhouse Monday-Thursday or our Tasting Room Friday-Sunday.Two beautiful spaces, one unforgettable destination! Our Hours:Monday - Thursday: Noon to 5:30pmFriday: Noon - 6:30pmSaturday: 11am-6:30pmSunday: Noon - 6:30pm We’re thrilled to welcome you to our beautiful tasting room, open Friday through Sunday. With plenty of seating available, there’s no need to worry about making a reservation-just stop by and enjoy the Augusta Vin experience at your own pace. We offer a variety of options to suit your preferences: seated bar tasting, limited inside table-seated tasting for more immersive experience, or outdoor patio seating for bottle, glass, and food.Reservations are not required
